app.name: Otiyot
app.tagline: A typing journey through the Land of Letters
common.keysHint: Type the gold letter, or use the arrows and Enter. Esc goes back.
menu.title: Main menu
menu.journeyHint: Your home: the map of the land, your lessons and Reb Ezra.
menu.styleguideHint: Developer page: every token and component
track.title: Choose how you learn
track.lead: Both tracks teach the whole keyboard and end in the same place. They differ in how the first letters arrive.
track.body1: You meet one new letter at a time, beginning with the home row where your fingers rest. Each letter is practised on its own before the next one joins.
track.body2: You learn two letters in every lesson, the most common ones first, and you are typing real words by the third lesson.
track.p1b: Calm and thorough: best if touch typing is new to you
track.p1c: Words come once the letters feel familiar
track.p2c: Best if you already type a little, or drills bore you
track.note: You can switch at any time. Progress is kept separately for each track, and what the game has learned about your fingers is shared by both.
layout.title: Choose your keyboard
layout.lead: This is the language you will practise typing. The language of the menus is separate; change it in the top corner.
layout.bodyHe: Learn to type Hebrew without looking. Your fingers rest on the gold keys.
layout.bodyEn: Learn to type English without looking. Your fingers rest on the gold keys.
layout.mapHe: Hebrew keyboard with the home row highlighted
layout.mapEn: English keyboard with the home row highlighted
players.title: Players
players.lead: Everyone who plays here has their own progress, settings and track.
players.deleteBody: All of this player's progress will be erased from this device. This cannot be undone.
wizard.nameHint: Just a first name or a nickname. It stays on this device.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Hebrew reads right to left, English left to right.
settings.colorblindHint: Correct and wrong use blue and orange instead of green and red.
settings.highContrastHint: Pure black and white ink, thicker borders.
settings.largeTextHint: Makes every menu and label bigger.
settings.dyslexiaHint: OpenDyslexic for English letters, wider spacing for Hebrew.
settings.reducedMotionHint: Keeps gentle fades, turns off movement, shake and flashes.
settings.soundRoomHint: Hear every theme, place and effect, and watch the music grow with a streak.
settings.backspaceHint: What happens when you press a wrong key.
settings.niqqudHint: For Hebrew lessons that show vowel marks.
settings.hardcoreHint: One wrong key ends the run. For experienced scribes.
pause.title: Paused
rank.label: Rank {rank}
sg.title: Design styleguide
sg.lead: Every token and component, in both themes and both directions.
sg.body: Body text for menus and labels.
sg.speaker: The old scribe
sg.line: The letters are fading from the land. Take the quill. Every key you strike brings one back.
sg.caption: Captions are always shown.
sg.heatLabel: Keyboard heatmap: the weakest keys are darkest
sg.chartTitle: Speed over the last ten sessions
sg.chartSummary: Speed rose from 18 to 41 words per minute over ten sessions.
sg.modalBody: Modals trap focus, close with Esc, and return focus where it was.
range.title: Test range
range.hint: Type the word on the paper strip; finish each word with space. Number keys play the effects; the arrows change the camera.
range.noWebgl: 3D graphics are not available in this browser or on this device.
range.failed: The 3D world could not be started.
range.benchmarked: Graphics quality set for this device: {quality}
guide.title: Keyboard guide
tip.wrongFinger: Try the {finger} for that key. Slow and steady.
tip.homeRowHe: Rest your fingers on the home row: index fingers on כ and ח, the keys with bumps.
tip.homeRowEn: Rest your fingers on the home row: index fingers on F and J, the keys with bumps.
settings.keyboardGuideHint: The keyboard under the game that lights the next key and the finger to use.
range.done.title: Lesson complete
range.done.again: Press Enter for the next lesson.
range.level.locked: This level opens after you learn {n} letters in your lessons.
range.results.smudges: Blots reached you {n} times. Type a little faster to keep them back.
sound.title: The sound room
sound.lead: Every tune and sound in the game. Type any letters here: each key climbs the scale, and the music grows with your streak.
sound.theme.title: Title: the scroll awakens
sound.mood.title: Slow and mysterious, a clarinet in candlelight
sound.mood.hub: Warm and cosy, an oud by the fire
sound.mood.meadow: Bright and bouncing, flute and darbuka
sound.mood.cliffs: Windy and climbing, a violin over the sea
sound.typeHere: Type letters to build a streak. Backspace plays a mistake and starts again.
title.beginHint: A blank sign, a spare quill, and you
title.continueHint: Back to the House of the Scribe, {name}
title.replayHint: The night the sign went blank
intro.label: The opening of the story
settings.textSpeedHint: How fast lines appear when characters speak.
settings.storyVoicesHint: Uses the voices built into your device, when it has them. Subtitles always stay on.
hub.title: The House of the Scribe
hub.hint: Type a word to walk there. Backspace takes a letter back.
hub.map.title: The Land of Letters
hub.map.lead: Regions restored: {n} of {total}. Grey is still forgotten.
hub.map.nextWriting: Its scene is still being written. Meanwhile, every lesson opens more of the land.
hub.map.writing: This region's scene is still being written.
hub.need.numbersSoon: Learn the number row first. Number lessons are not in the course yet.
hub.trophies.lead: Every restored region leaves a gold seal on the shelf, with its best rank.
hub.soon.shop: Inks, quills and robes for your glyphs and ink open here soon.
hub.soon.journal: Your journal of speeds, streaks and keys opens here soon.
hub.soon.gameRoom: The Game Room and its arcade of sixteen games open soon. Dyo is still sweeping.
region.meadow.place: Spring morning, anemones and the home row.
region.cliffs.place: A desert canyon: reach up to the top row and down to the bottom.
region.forge.place: A glowing smithy where numbers keep the fire steady.
region.shuk.place: A lantern-lit market where punctuation is money.
region.rail.place: A clockwork train race against Naftali.
region.geniza.place: A flooded archive: type with the tide.
region.hermon.place: A storm flight on a great eagle.
region.station.place: A floating observatory counting the stars.
region.atbash.place: Rainy streets of code-breakers and ciphers.
region.midbar.place: A sandstorm crossing toward the oasis.
region.caves.place: Dark chalk caves: keep the lantern lit.
region.arena.place: An old stone theatre where the bosses wait.
region.scroll.place: The Keeper's archive, white and endless.
region.ladder.place: A tower of letters for endless free play.
lesson.label: Lesson
lesson.allDoneBody: Every lesson of this track is passed. The land is yours to restore.
lesson.needs: Reach 90% accuracy to pass and open the next lesson. Slow and right beats fast.
meadow.options.noTimers: Nothing in the Meadow counts down, on any difficulty. Harder ones ask for longer words and forgive fewer slips; the Sofer’s Trial ends at the first one.
meadow.results.restored: The Meadow is restored. Its beacon is lit on the map in the house.
cliffs.options.noTimers: Nothing on the Cliffs counts down, on any difficulty. Harder ones ask for longer words and forgive fewer slips; the Sofer’s Trial ends at the first one.
cliffs.results.restored: The Cliffs are restored. Their beacon is lit on the map in the house.
region.blot.place: The Silent Arena: everything the Fading took has gathered into one great blot.
hub.need.after: First defeat {region} in the Silent Arena.
arena.phase.how.p1: Single words: each one bursts a glob in the air.
arena.phase.how.p2: Sentences: a whole sentence cuts a tendril.
arena.phase.how.p3: A passage: keep typing to hold back the ink.
arena.phase.how.p4: The mirror: the stolen words come back, last first.
arena.options.timers: On Calm nothing reaches you: the attacks come close and wait. On harder difficulties an attack lands if you stop for long, and your streak drops. Calm, Steady and Swift keep a checkpoint at every new phase; the Sofer’s Trial ends at the first slip.
arena.results.restored: The Great Blot is undone and the Silent Arena is restored. The road of Act Two is open on the map.
sound.mood.forge: A hammering groove, oud and cello with taiko on the anvil beat
forge.options.noTimers: Nothing in the Forge counts down, on any difficulty. A fire that is too low or too high only dulls a letter. Harder ones ask for longer numbers and forgive fewer slips; the Sofer’s Trial ends at the first one.
forge.results.restored: The Forge is restored. Its fire is lit on the map in the house.
forge.empty: The Forge needs the number row first.
sound.mood.shuk: A swinging, chattering groove, kanun and clarinet over a frame drum with a bell for every coin
shuk.options.noTimers: Nothing in the Shuk counts down, on any difficulty. A slip only breaks your streak of clean deals. Harder ones ask for more kinds of marks and forgive fewer slips; the Sofer’s Trial ends at the first one.
shuk.results.restored: The Night Shuk is restored. Its lanterns are lit on the map in the house.
